response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (15+ years) fullstack engineer with deep polyglot programming skills, strong TypeScript/Node.js background, and direct current experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which directly matches the role's AI agent development requirement. His breadth across backend, frontend, databases, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD is excellent, though his frontend experience leans more toward Ember.js than React, and there's no explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin, which are core/secondary stack items for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of fullstack experience across web, backend, and infrastructure, far exceeding the 6+ year requirement
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflows — a direct match to a required skill
Polyglot engineer (TypeScript, Java, C#, DLang, PHP) with strong architecture, testing culture (built own test frameworks), and DevOps/Kubernetes exposure
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin, which are named in the primary/secondary stack
